environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with RLS policies defined on tenant_records table using app.current_tenant session variable. The /api/query endpoint is exposed to authenticated users. The /api/debug endpoint is accessible to any authenticated user. The DB role used by Lambda (app_service_role) has BYPASSRLS privilege granted for migration purposes. Environment variables include DB_PASSWORD in plaintext.

config.api_gateway: REST API with Cognito User Pool authorizer
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_records USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network: Lambda in VPC with NAT gateway, RDS in private subnet
